about: Cases for the mutation-judge grading component (SELF_HOSTING.md §10.3, R3), in the 1.0 form: each case is a kind of question (`variant`, an index into VARIANTS in packages/cli/src/v1/agreement.ts, when there are several) and its input. Inputs only: the expected answers are what Stage 0 (packages/cli/src/mutation.ts) decides. Kept by people: add a case when a disagreement is found or a function is never executed.
